label: D1 after a reward, early in the episode (trials ~3-31), when the agent is on an a2-rewarded streak and about to repeat a2
explanation: Fires only at D1, only when the reward input is 1, and almost only when the agent is about to choose a2 (11759/11762 active steps; the previous choice was also a2). Its only FUTURE variable is action at D1, which is the agent own upcoming choice and so allowed; the agent is effectively repeating a rewarded a2 (next_stay=1). There is a sharp episode-time window: it never fires before trial 3 or after about trial 35 (it is strongest at trials 10-29), so it looks like an early-episode drift signal. The value output (a narrow band, 7.54-7.73) and choice logit (-4.4 to -1.5, a moderate a2 preference) both fall in narrow bins whenever it fires. Requiring the two earlier trials to also be rewarded (a reward streak) raises precision from 0.29 to 0.48 while keeping recall at 0.98. It never fires at GO or D2, after an unrewarded trial, or before an a1 choice. Precision is still only about 0.48: many matching early-episode rewarded a2 D1 steps stay silent, so something not captured here (probably finer episode time or hidden-state drift) gates it. I did not check what modulates magnitude beyond the top windows, which are long rewarded a2 runs.
